_comment: Committable .claude/settings.json for an L9 consumer repo. Copy to .claude/settings.json
and commit it: on Claude Code Web/Mobile only git-tracked files survive the clone, so a
committed settings.json is what makes governance boot with no manual step. On the CLI the
same file is picked up locally. Keep secrets OUT of this file — they belong in the account
environment (web/environment.env.example) or user-scope config, never in a repo.
Field/event names track the Claude Code release; see https://code.claude.com/docs.
